page.layout: One page of text, one column. Running head at top left, page number at top right. Continuous text from the previous page, then a title above a chapter, a chapter heading (CAP. VI.), and a paragraph with a woodcut initial and Greek. No marginal notes. Gathering signature at foot right.

main_text.l: Ecquemnam igitur in iis exponendis or-
dinem sequemur? Eum nimirum, qui natu-
ræ accómodatus est maximè: ut quo quisque
rei propositæ adiunctior est, eum potissimum
Primum igitur de iis dicemus, qui in re ipsa
insiti sunt, hoc est de Genere, Specie, Toto &
Partibus. Tum deinde de externis: è quibus
eos primùm qui consentanei sunt, tum eos
trarij inter diffentaneos summum locum ob-
QVID est Genus? Notio, quæ sui si-
est. Illa autem Aristotelis: γένος ἐςὶ τὸ κοινὸν ἀλε-[?] ἀλλήλων ἢ διαφερόντων
τῷ εἴδει ἐν τῷ τι ἔχει κατηγορού-[?] μενον, id est, Genus est, quod de pluribus, specie

page.notes: The woodcut initial is a decorated Q, read as QVID. The Greek lines in the second half of the paragraph are only partly legible at this resolution; the marked words are my best reading. The word "diffentanæ" is copied as printed, not corrected. Long s is read as s throughout. The line "Dif-similia" is printed as "Dif-" with a hyphen at the line end, read as Dis-similia.
